invariants.rationale: writeClient is used to invoke methods in the method, so it cannot be null at exit.
instantTime is passed to invoked writeClient methods, so it is expected to be non-null.
preppedRecordInputs is passed as an argument to a method call, requiring it to be non-null at usage.
Result of upsertPreppedRecords is immediately used in commit, so it must be non-null.
The result is a List, and List.size() is always non-negative.
